instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot. On a sunny autumn path in a wooded park, the woman in the black puffer jacket and mint beanie (R1) walks forward while carrying the toddler girl in the pink turban beanie (R2) piggyback on her back, both looking forward. In the background on the right, a young boy in a dark jacket and grey pants walks along the path. Bright sunlight filters through the trees, casting shadows across the leaf-strewn ground.
